app.title: PDF Editor
bar.label: Tools
panel.empty: Create your signature: draw it, or import a photo or an image of it. Then click it and click on the page.
panel.hint: Click a stamp, then click where it goes on the page (or press Enter). You can also drag it. Hold Shift to place it several times.
panel.deleteText: It leaves your stamps. Signatures already placed in this document stay.
panel.openFirst: Open a PDF to place it on a page.
empty.title: Sign a PDF
empty.body: Open a PDF, place your signatures and stamps, save. The file never leaves the device.
new.title: New signature or stamp
new.drawHint: Sign here with the mouse, a finger or a pen
new.imageHint: A PNG or JPG file: a photo of your signature on paper, or an image already without background. The background is removed below.
new.name: Name
new.placeHint: Now click where it goes on the page.
open.discardText: The signatures placed in this document have not been saved and will be lost.
err.tooBig: The file is too large (200 MB at most).
err.notPdf: This file is not a PDF.
err.open: This PDF cannot be opened: it may be damaged.
err.encrypted: This PDF is encrypted: you can view it, but not yet save it with signatures.
err.unwritable: This PDF's structure cannot be changed safely: you can only view it.
err.oldShell: This system cannot save files from apps yet: update the device. Meanwhile, use Print and choose "Save as PDF".
err.busySave: A save has just started: try again in a moment.
err.full: Stamp storage is full: delete one, or use this one only this time.
pw.title: Password-protected PDF
pw.text: Enter the password to open it.
page.label: Page {n}
save.nothing: Place at least one signature or stamp first.
pages.hint: Drag to reorder. Ctrl or Shift to pick more than one.
pages.empty: Open a PDF to see its pages.
pages.lastOne: A PDF needs at least one page.
err.emptyStamp: Nothing visible is left: lower the strength or pick another image.
img.eraserHint: Paint over what should go away.
